description: Create a ServeReel image post on the connected account. Requires a connected ServeReel account (one-click sign-in).

headline.description: The headline text on the image post, for example 'Fresh bagels every morning'.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying so the post is only created once.

image_base64.description: Optional background photo as base64 data (JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 20MB).

image_url.description: Optional public http or https link to a background photo.

qr.description: Add the business QR code badge.

qr_link.description: Where the QR code should point. Defaults to the business website.

name: create_image_post
